dimensions.assessment: Affects foreign nationals and political fundraising entities involved in state or local ballot measures and recall elections.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits contributions or donations by foreign nationals in connection with state or local ballot initiatives, referenda, or recall elections

dimensions.assessment: Extends an existing prohibition to a specific category of elections, maintaining consistency in campaign finance rules.
dimensions.evidence: apply the prohibition against contributions and donations by foreign nationals in connection with elections

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or economic effects are stated.
Makes a narrow textual amendment to the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971.
dimensions.evidence: Section 319(a)(1)(A) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a permanent statutory prohibition effective for contributions made on or after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: shall apply with respect to contributions and donations made on or after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: The amount of foreign funds currently contributed to ballot initiatives or referenda is not quantified.
importance_detail.rationale: Applies existing foreign national contribution and donation prohibitions to state and local ballot initiatives, referenda, and recall elections.
